newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies four muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies four muni issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following four municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Padre Dam Municipal Water, Calif., $11.2 million certificates of participation.
--Battle Creek, Mich., $12.43 million water supply system revenue bonds, by direct purchase.
--Butler Area School District, Pa., $4.995 million general obligation bonds, by direct purchase.
--Colleyville Economic Development, Texas, $6.46 million sales tax revenue bonds, by direct purchase.
